method: AI image generation; runtime crops compressed to WebP

assets.trails: Four light Swiss alpine ground materials: hiking gravel, woodland roots, farm track, scree. Applied as repeating 3D path textures.
assets.meadows: Four Swiss alpine ground variants: lush meadow, autumn meadow, forest floor, summit turf. Applied by region.
assets.winter: Swiss alpine snowy panorama; used as distant scenery and a cropped snow surface.
assets.daniel: Swiss mountain guide character reference; procedural 3D interpretation.
assets.hut: Swiss touring hut exterior reference; constructed 3D hut and accessible interior.

originals: Source PNGs retained beside this manifest. Reduced pre-existing runtime textures retained losslessly in retained-originals.
